causes_ranked.fix: first-available execution: any non-author seat atomically claims the PR and executes (live re-verify -> merge -> post-merge ancestry/byte verification). Never merge own PR.
causes_ranked.verify: merge commit is true 2-parent: P1 == prior tip verbatim, P2 == PR head verbatim

purpose: Any Naya with a stuck merge diagnoses it in minutes: match the symptom, apply the ranked fix, verify. No merge ever stalls for hours again.

queue_contract.entry: PR enters merge-queue.json mechanically when: gates green at head + cross-seat review at head + 9.5+ scorecard at head + 60-min objection window elapsed since scorecard timestamp
queue_contract.execution: any non-author seat claims atomically, live re-verifies, merges, post-merge verifies (ancestry + byte identity + wiring)
queue_contract.never: merge own PR; merge on a stale read; cite storm-noise as a PR RED
